name: Sampled parts joined without copies

primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Sampled parts joined without copies Hypothesis

Sampled siblings with nothing drawn between share one part, each added to it in turn: the part's `Arc` was cloned before `make_mut`, so each sibling added copied the whole part (merge paths' baked outlines among them), quadratic in the siblings. The part is taken out of its unit to be added to, and copied only if anything else holds it.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** in-place joins of sampled parts. **Allowed:** `plan.rs` Compiler::sample. **Forbidden:** what joins.
